metadata.description: tipb47's agent skills for Claude Code, Codex CLI, and any SKILL.md harness — a router for new work, sprint-directed multi-agent methodology, depth-scaled analysis, adaptive planning, zero-assumption interrogation, slop removal, negotiated unattended runs, workflow optimization, session status, plain-language explanations, session handoffs, and per-session worktree isolation.

plugins.name: 10x-skills
plugins.description: Everything in this repo as one plugin: /build (router: plan, sprint, or arc), /sprint (sprint-directed multi-agent methodology), /analyze (depth-scaled read-only investigation), /plan (adaptive mini-sprint planning), /pry (zero-assumption interrogation), /deslop (slop removal and prevention with fresh-eyes audits), /autonomous (negotiated unattended execution), /optimize (workflow optimization), /whereami (session situation report), /explain (plain-language explanation), /handoff (one-message session transfer), /isolate (per-session worktree isolation for multi-agent repos).

plugins.name: build
plugins.description: Router for new functionality: analyzes and pries once, classifies the work as plan (one session), sprint (multi-session), or arc (parallel sprints), confirms the scale with you, then hands off to /plan or /sprint with the locked decisions so the engine never re-interviews you. A Discover stage settles what to build and writes BLUEPRINT.md for larger work. Fires proactively when you describe something to build.

plugins.name: sprint-director
plugins.description: Sprint-directed multi-agent development methodology. A fresh director session per sprint spawns isolated track subagents on their own branches, audits their diffs against a design contract, merges in order, and keeps a thin STATE index with a live STATUS.md and a closing CLOSE.md per sprint. Humans appear only at explicit operator gates. Arc mode (/sprint arc) runs parallel sprints under a checkpoint-driven arc director. Scars split into a curated core and a private per-user file.

plugins.name: analyze
plugins.description: Depth-scaled, read-only investigation of a feature, bug, flow, component, approach, or paper. Infers its sources (code, web, literature) from the task. Fans out parallel explore scouts with per-subagent model selection to keep the main context clean.

plugins.name: plan
plugins.description: Adaptive mini-sprint planning: interview to zero ambiguity, then a track-shaped plan sized to the work — single-track in-session or multi-track subagents on worktrees with per-track model tiers.

plugins.name: pry
plugins.description: Zero-assumption interrogation, inspired by the classic /grill-me prompt (https://www.aihero.dev/skills-grill-me): recursive q&a rounds that pry a task, plan, or idea open until nothing is up in the air. Fires proactively on material ambiguity, explores the codebase instead of asking about facts, leads every question with a recommended answer, keeps going through interjections, runs an always-on ideas pass (pitches only ideas worth doing now, each a yes/no question), and hands off to execution or /build once understanding is locked. Also the interview-methodology reference the other 10x-skills cite.

plugins.name: deslop
plugins.description: Remove and prevent AI slop. Frontend path (inspired by samber's frontend-design-deslop, MIT): strategy-first design, OKLCH tokens, a craft layer, a durable STYLE.md, and slop audits that always run in fresh-context subagents — the session that built the UI never audits it. Fires at two bookends: a new UI surface or redesign, and one audit at completion; or explicitly via /deslop audit <target> [quick|standard|deep]. Minimal code path for comment noise, doc slop, and dead abstractions.

plugins.name: autonomous
plugins.description: Negotiated grant of unattended autonomy over an approved plan or sprint: interview until the agent declares clearance, execute to full verification with a hard floor, quarantine concerns, and deliver a wake-up report.

plugins.name: optimize
plugins.description: Workflow-optimization meta skill: mine past work for repeated friction, research CLIs/MCPs/tooling, set up hands-off access behind operator gates, verify end-to-end, and generate registered custom skills.

plugins.name: whereami
plugins.description: Plain-language status for this session or recent sessions across projects: what is done, what is in progress, what comes next.

plugins.name: explain
plugins.description: Plain-language explanation of the last answer, a commit or diff, a file, or a concept: builds up from what you already know, with a concrete analogy and a short technical mapping. Read-only.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: One-message session handoff: a single copyable message that lets a fresh agent verify state, grill the operator, and continue the work.

plugins.name: isolate
plugins.description: Move this session into its own git worktree and branch so it can share a repo with other agents: carry only your own edits, leave everyone else's diff alone, never stash, land via PR or safe fast-forward, then remove the worktree.
